Use explicit user confirmation." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-(rf|r|fr)\s"; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -r/rm -rf requires explicit user approval. Ask first." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^mv\s.*/$"; then echo "BLOCKED: mv on directories requires explicit user approval. Ask first." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
